domain: Online payment processing platform handling real-time card authorisations for e-commerce merchants.

glossary.definition: Core transaction processing component responsible for card authorisation, settlement, and refund operations.
Scheduled period during which the platform undergoes planned updates, patches, or infrastructure changes.
Automated probe that issues synthetic transaction requests every 60 seconds and records success or failure against the payment service endpoint.

business_rules.rule: Availability metrics must be reported to stakeholders in a monthly SLA dashboard generated on the first business day of each month, covering the preceding calendar month.
